set.body: Freeze two secondary follow-up gates without modifying GW-13: (1) a full-cohort study-repeat ceiling using all four study presentations under common held-out K=5 candidates, including initial-to-later and adjacent-repeat contrasts; (2) full-cohort probe/delay scoring with response class (hit, miss, correct rejection, false alarm), saliency, and phase. Preserve participant/item cross-fitting, candidate-invariant registration, common comparators, restricted-data local-only policy, and crossed uncertainty. Establish study sensitivity before interpreting retrieval conditional effects; label all post-GW-13 recognition analyses secondary.
set.title: GW-15 Run full-cohort repetition and phase-conditional courts
